name: @baukit/pwa-web
description: Cache strategy, cleanup, and a classic worker artifact for web PWAs.
author: Patrick Koss

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/build-worker.mjs && node --input-type=module -e "import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', '{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}\\n')"
scripts.test: pnpm run build && vitest run --config ../../vitest.config.ts && pnpm run test:artifact && pnpm run test:package
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.cjs.json
